candidate: Borrowing support like that is basically borrowed adulthood. At first you may need to feel protected or loved by something bigger than you, before that love gradually starts to feel like your own. Send some of it down to your frightened little one, and when that's possible, toward whatever you're afraid of. Continuing to relate to benevolent spiritual powers/beings is still perfectly fine, but they would surely be happy if they rubbed off on you!

edits.old: before that love starts to feel like yours, and then bit by bit it starts to become your own.
edits.new: before that love gradually starts to feel like your own.
edits.why: The original says the same thing twice ('starts to feel like yours' and 'starts to become your own'), which makes the sentence clumsy. Merging them keeps the gradual shift.
